gloss: bottled (goods); something preserved or stored in a bottle or jar

definitions.gloss: bottled (goods); something preserved or stored in a bottle or jar
definitions.explanation: Food or other items preserved in glass bottles or jars. Refers both to the preserved goods themselves and to the method of preservation. Commonly associated with homemade jams, pickles, and preserved fruits.

examples.japanese: {瓶詰|びんづめ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ジャム→ジャム：01779_jamu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{買|か}った→買う：00489_kau⟧。
⟦{自家製|じかせい}→自家製：13947_jikasei⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{果物|くだもの}→果物：00509_kudamono⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{瓶詰|びんづめ}にして⟦{保存|ほぞん}→保存：03626_hozon⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: I preserve homemade fruit in jars.

examples.english: Every autumn, Grandma would bottle plums and distribute them to relatives.

notes:
Refers to food or other items preserved in glass bottles or jars. Often written as {瓶詰|びんづめ}め with the trailing め in casual contexts, though the standard form is {瓶詰|びんづめ}. Used both as a noun (bottled goods) and in the pattern ～⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ (to bottle something).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {瓶詰|びんづめ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to bottle, to preserve in jars
- {瓶詰|びんづめ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ジャム→ジャム：01779_jamu⟧: bottled jam
- {瓶詰|びんづめ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{蜂蜜|はちみつ}→蜂蜜：14045_hachimitsu⟧: bottled honey
- {瓶詰|びんづめ}⟦{食品|しょくひん}→食品：03247_shokuhin⟧: bottled food products

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{缶詰|かんづめ}→缶詰：00187_kanzume⟧: canned goods — preserved in metal cans rather than glass
- ⟦{漬物|つけもの}→漬物：04938_tsukemono⟧: pickles — preserved by brining or fermenting, not necessarily in bottles
